asr.full_text: Are you a Kenyan content creator, maybe you have not yet been monetized yet wondering how can I be able to make money when I don't have adsense I have the solution for you and I'm going to teach you all the steps that you need to take in order to get started in affiliate marketing let lets get those credits rolling What is affiliate marketing? Now to describe this I'll use a simple analogy If you work in a shop and you are paid by commission. You are basically an affiliate. Now, the difference is just a little more than how simple I have put it. If you're in a shop and you're employed, you're probably getting a retainer and then anything you get above that is a commission. If you have actually reached the target, whatever you have above that would be a commission but if you are an affiliate then you can actually do the things that you do the business that you do all the things that you want to do and then at the end of the day you talk about a particular product and if you can be able to assist the business owner to sell a unit of their product then they will give you a percentage of the amount of money that you have helped them make. For instance, someone may want to sell this particular phone and say this phone is a thousand shillings then the owner will say that if you help me sell this a thousand shilling phone i will give you 10% of that which is a hundred now all i will need to do is actually go out and look for someone who has the thousand shillings in order to be able to buy this phone and then i will tell them where to purchase it and where they're going to purchase is a business owner who stole me that they will give me 10 percent. And the moment that I am able to bring the paying customer and that paid customer says I was sent by more or to buy this phone. Then that particular business will need to pay me ten percent like we had agreed now this is the basic way of how it works so how can you as a content creator be able to incorporate this into the things that you do I will give a nice example of a makeup artists And while I do this I'll show some images of a makeup artist now as a makeup artist what are you doing and teaching people how to do make up on your channel you're using the different products and as your description shows this is the product that you're using different products and as your description shows Those are the different products that you're actually using Now the next step would be if I am a viewer and I want to create the same Look that you have on your channel. What is a first thing that I would want to do I will want to buy the same Products that you have actually bought in order to get the same product that you have actually bought in order to get the same result that you have got. Now this is an opportunity for you, if you can be able to direct me to the place where I can be able to purchase this things. Of course most of these things are at the same price so you're not necessarily providing a price value you providing a convenience value. I am trying to see if I can see and see if I am getting this information. So basically the prices. So it is interesting here. The price is different. So let me get off camera. I will show you that I will see how much it is selling, whether it is selling in a certain area or I will see it in a certain area of my room. So the price is the same and it is the same price. So they only come up with that price. a one way application here as I'm going to show you this one is one way application I will show you, with screenshots from iPhone, what you do is you go on the Jumia app, actually go to Google and search for Jumia affiliates the next thing that you're going to do, of course, in the description I'll put the same link for Jumia an affiliate, you will get what is known as the affiliate dashboard. This shows you the amount of sales that you have made in the past 30 days and the value of those items and how much you have made as a person and the site will tell you when it is possible to cash out the amount of money that you have made in the month if your items are on Amazon then you need to sign up as an Amazon associate when you do this then you can be able to have links in your description the same way that you can be able to see a few here from the equipment that I use from the mics that I use from the lights that i use you can find them in the description when you go into the link and you click on the link and purchase within a set frame time whatever you purchase the commission that is there is based on the value of the items that the password has actually bought on the site so this is how affiliate marketing works you can get paid weekly bi-weekly or monthly depending on the site when you are on the jumia site going back to jimmy up when you're on the jumia site you can pick the link like I am right now and then you will take it to your affiliate and once you place it it to your affiliate and once you place it there it will generate another link this link that you're actually creating has a referral code that is how the company is able to assign a particular seal to you so when your audience member now clicks on this link to purchase this product they want from you then you are attributed that particular single week because you are the reason why that person visited the site then that sale belongs to you so because the sale belongs to you than the commission as well belongs to you and the company now Jumia wants to reward you because of bringing this particular customer to them so that is the basic idea of how Affiliate marketing works. I hope that you as a Kenyan content creator can start using affiliate links in your description. Don't leave your descriptions blank. Help yourself make some money and I'll see you in the next video.
